assumptions.text: Every treated roof reaches albedo 0.55 (aged coating, not fresh).
Roof emissivity unchanged.
All roof area in the drawn cells is treated; roof slope and access are ignored.
Roof heat storage (OHM) unchanged: the coating is thin.
Treated road surfaces reach albedo 0.30.
Pavement emissivity unchanged.
Light reflected onto walls and pedestrians is not modelled.
Pavement heat storage (OHM) unchanged.
Canopy share added: 10% of the cell, capped at the paved/bare area.
Canopy replaces paved and bare in proportion to their area.
Trees are not irrigated: they use the cell's soil moisture.
Canopy is mature: full leaf area from day one.
Cell roughness and sky view unchanged; ventilation effects are not counted.
50% of the roof area is greened.
Green roofs behave like the cell's grass: albedo, emissivity, storage, resistance.
Green roofs are irrigated.
Substrate moisture = the cell's soil moisture.
The roof-top grass uses the cell's canyon sky view, which understates its open sky.
Structural feasibility is not checked.
50% of paved (non-road) area becomes permeable grass.
The new surface has the cell's grass properties.
Soil moisture unchanged: no extra infiltration assumed.
Human-made heat cut by 30% in treated cells, all sources alike.
Uses the model's qf map; only meaningful where real energy-release data exist.
The heat is released at the surface, spread over roofs, roads and paving.
